title: STEGO's own tree holds the rule: package of two domains is not found in it
when: Runs assure.packageOfTwoDomains over STEGO's own source tree at the commit under test.
then: Expects no fault, so the rule holds for STEGO itself at every commit the test runs at.

title: No generator source imports a package for files, processes or the network, or calls an HTTP client or server
when: Parses every non-test Go file under internal/generator, and lists each import and each package-qualified name, through any import alias.
then: Expects no import of os, os/exec, os/signal, io/ioutil, syscall, net or plugin, and no use of an HTTP client, transport, server or file server.
notes: The generators use net/http only to check route patterns on an in-memory ServeMux, and net/url and net/textproto only to parse text, so those packages stay allowed.

title: No generator source reads the clock, a timer, the environment or a source of randomness
when: Parses every non-test Go file under internal/generator, as ST-STD-GEN-R01-T01 does.
then: Expects no use of time.Now, timers, context deadlines, os.Getenv and its kin, math/rand or crypto/rand. The test can list a known violation, and fails when a listed use is gone; the list is empty.
notes: The gRPC generator stopped proto compilation after 10 seconds until 2026-10-28. The timeout was removed, because the compiler's input size limits already bound the proto files.

title: Planning each built-in archetype ten times gives the same files in the same order
when: With a project for each built-in archetype: rest-crud, rpc-service and browser-service: Plans each project ten times in one process. Go starts each map iteration at a random place.
then: Expects every plan of a project to hold the same files, in the same order, with the same content.
notes: Not proof yet. The three archetypes reach 10 of the 26 components. These are not reached: cli-application, controller, go-sdk, grpc-application, http-application, kafka-producer, keycloak-provider, kubernetes-client, kubernetes-workload, outbox, postgres-client, rh-sso-auth, runtime-configuration, typescript-sdk, user-management and user-management-rhsso. A project for each of them, or a fixture context per generator, would make the test proof.

title: The compiler contains a generator for every component the registry ships
when: Lists the components in registry/components and the generators the compiler build holds.
then: Expects each component to have a generator, and each generator to have a component.

title: Qualification fails when the signed artifact run holds a second artifact
when: Qualifies a release whose signed artifact run also holds a separate generator artifact.
then: Expects qualification to fail on an unknown artifact, so a release ships one compiler.

title: A component with no generator in the compiler build stops compilation before anything is written
when: Compiles a service whose component has no generator, a nil generator or a typed nil generator.
then: Expects a validation error and no plan, with no output, go.mod or .stego written; the compiler looks for no generator elsewhere.

title: No compiler source imports the plugin package
when: Parses the imports of every non-test Go source under cmd and internal, outside testdata.
then: Expects no import of Go's plugin package, so the compiler cannot load code at run time.
notes: This shows the compiler cannot load code. It does not show that the compiler downloads or runs no generator code by other means.
